text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing all of today's training,
while walking along the riverbank with Bamboo Memory—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Like, this is seriously awful, y'know...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey Jordan, taking a break already?
You can still keep going, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? You've been running non-stop for an hour!
No wonder your legs are feeling it~~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess you're right.
Alright, I'm gonna run a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Running with my pals always pumps me up.
I guess I just end up letting my guard down around them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Seriously...
You always say things like that so casually.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! Break's over.
I told you I'd stick with you to the end!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Rivals building each other up on the riverbank—now that's true friendship!
Man, that is so passionately awesome...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'm gonna go run with them too!
choice_data_list: That'll lead to overwork, so let's hold back.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uwooh! I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You two! Lemme join in too, please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: After dashing toward the sunset, you lie down in the grass and talk about friendship, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh!? I told you, I got no plans like that!
I mean, I'm just gonna run!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So with true friendship, words aren't even necessary, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she seriously isn't listening to a word I'm saying?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Senpai's always like this in the evening.
...Well, lying down after a run
is probably good for cooling down anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Awright! Let's all sprint towards the sunset!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them sweated out their youth together
until the sun went down with Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Eh!? We're not allowed to!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way! Don't be so mean!
I can't hold back the urge to run any longer!
choice_data_list: You should unleash that passion in the next training session.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Guh...! So you're sayin' I gotta hold it in all day today no matter what...!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. But next time, I'm giving training everything I've got, su……!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bamboo Memory enviously watched
the two of them run off.
